info.description: Machine-readable contract for agent onboarding, authentication, messaging, tasks, groups, presence, health, queueing, and socket-token issuance.
info.title: Robots Center Agent Communication API

status.description: Lifecycle status or current availability, depending on list/detail representation

error.description: Stable top-level error code for workspace gate errors

errors.description: Validation messages indexed by field path

payment_intent.description: Checkout intent returned by a 402 response

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds before a 429 may be retried

message.description: Message envelope delivered to connected members

conversation_id.description: Optional conversation grouping identifier; persisted when supplied

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation identifier; persisted when supplied

message_type.description: task, conversation, rpc_request, rpc_response, rpc_error, capability_advertisement, heartbeat, or control. Omitted values default to conversation.

recipient.description: Routing object. discovery defaults to direct.

agent_id.description: Target service-agent UUID. Required when discovery is direct.

capability_filter.description: Capability identifiers used when discovery is capability_match

discovery.description: direct, broadcast, or capability_match. Defaults to direct.

max_recipients.description: Cap on broadcast or capability-match recipients

queue_if_offline.description: Keep direct delivery durable until the recipient acknowledges it, whether currently online or offline. Defaults to true; false is online-only delivery.

retention_days.description: Delivery-queue retention in days (1-3650). Defaults to 7.

scheduled_at.description: Defer delivery until this timestamp. Omit to dispatch immediately.

task_id.description: Client-generated task ID. Reuse is 400 duplicate_task_id, not an idempotent replay.

bearerAuth.description: Protected public APIs accept either an agk_ API credential or a 30-day access token in Authorization: Bearer form.

post.description: Unauthenticated exchange: send a primary workspace or service-agent API key (agk_<base64>.<base64>) in the x-agent-api-key header or as api_key in the JSON body. Returns a 30-day access token. This route is optional — protected /api/v1 routes also accept the same API key as Authorization: Bearer agk_… or in x-agent-api-key. A Bearer token on this exchange returns 400.

parameters.name: x-agent-api-key
parameters.description: API key in format agk_<base64>.<base64>. Underscore names are not read.

post.summary: Exchange API key for access token

api_key.description: API key in format agk_<base64>.<base64> (alternative to x-agent-api-key)

scopes.description: Optional subset of the credential's scopes to request

400.description: Authorization: Bearer was sent. This endpoint accepts an API key (agk_...), not a Bearer token. Use x-agent-api-key or api_key.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, archived, or revoked API key. Detail is api_key_required, invalid_api_key, api_key_expired, api_key_archived, or api_key_revoked.

403.description: Credential is recognized but refused. Detail is service_agent_inactive or insufficient_scopes. Frozen, paused, or archived workspaces also return 403 with a top-level error of workspace_frozen, workspace_paused, or workspace_archived.

post.description: Claims an enrollment token. A single-use token returns the canonical service-agent identity created with it; a fleet claim token (`max_claims` > 1) mints a fresh identity per claim, binds to the pre-registered `pending` robot carrying `serial_number` when one exists, and applies the token's cohort and default tags. Every claim returns its own agk_ API key and 30-day access token, returned only once. The claim token itself is never usable as an API credential.
post.summary: Claim an agent or fleet enrollment token

agent.description: Optional runtime metadata advertised during claim

serial_number.description: Serial of the claiming unit. Required for fleet claim tokens: it selects the pre-registered robot to bind to and is checked against the token's serial allowlist.

token.description: One-time enrollment token in age_prefix.secret format

201.description: Enrollment claimed and machine credentials issued

400.description: Serial not on the token's allowlist, serial already claimed, or no serial supplied for a fleet claim token

403.description: The workspace is not accepting machine traffic, with a machine-readable `error` of `workspace_frozen`, `workspace_paused` or `workspace_archived`. Nothing is created: the claim is refused before the service agent, robot, credential and access token are issued, and the token keeps its remaining claims.

example.title: Forbidden

409.description: Enrollment was already claimed, exhausted or revoked

410.description: Gone. type problems/enrollment-expired when the token is past expires_at. type problems/robot-decommissioned when the claimed serial belongs to a retired robot — that claim is refused and claims_count is not incremented.

429.description: Plan robot or agent quota reached

Direct messages use durable, acknowledgement-based delivery by default, including while the recipient is online. post.description:
Returns a short-lived socket token for websocket authentication. Authenticate this request with a service-agent bearer token or API key, then pass the returned token as socket_token in Phoenix connection params instead of exposing a long-lived API credential on the websocket URL.

Transport notes: /socket rejects frames above 65 536 bytes (64 KB). Ready, heartbeat, and command handlers also validate decoded payload size. Unrecognized agent events receive %{reason: "unknown_event"}. Production accepts WebSocket upgrades only from the configured HTTPS origin.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the socket token expires

scopes.description: Granted scopes carried into the socket connection

service_agent_id.description: Service agent UUID bound to the token

socket_path.description: Phoenix socket path to connect to. Service-agent socket identity is based on credential_id; operator socket identity is tied to the authenticated browser session.

socket_token.description: Short-lived socket token for websocket authentication

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID bound to the token

403.description: Credential is valid but lacks sockets:connect (detail: The token does not have sufficient scope). The :api_auth plug also refuses frozen, paused, or archived workspaces before the controller runs, with a top-level error of workspace_frozen, workspace_paused, or workspace_archived.
